title: Two-sided addition
preamble: Certain pairs of words of equal length may be ‘added’ in the following sense to produce two new words: the pair of first, second, third . . . letters of the resulting words shall equal respectively the pair of first, second, third . . . letters of the original pair. For example SAILOR + POSTED = PASTOR + SOILED Each clue is in fact two non-overlapping clues which lead to two words of equal length. These must be ‘added’ and the resulting words entered in the congruent diagrams under the appropriate clue number; either word may occupy either diagram. Chambers’ Twentieth Century Dictionary, 1972 Edition, is recommended. The unchecked letters in the left-hand diagram may be rearranged to form SUCCESS AWAITS AGILE EXPERTS: I GUARD!
